- Clearly communicate results to stakeholders through verbal and written communication

- Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and reason through them rigorously

- Comfortable defining metrics, forming hypotheses, and evaluating trade-offs to guide decisions

title: Data Scientist - Fraud
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

We are the Data team within Plaid’s Fraud organization. We build the machine learning systems that power Plaid’s fraud detection products, leveraging Plaid’s network data to help identify and prevent fraud before it happens. Our team owns the end-to-end ML lifecycle, from feature pipelines and model training to production serving and monitoring, ensuring our systems are reliable, scalable, and built to support hundreds of customers and data partners.

As a Data Scientist on the Fraud Data team, you will analyze customer and network traffic to understand how Plaid Protect performs across a range of use cases and customer segments. You’ll build dashboards and metrics that provide a clear, shared view of product performance, run backtests to evaluate performance and identify high-impact rules and model strategies, and generate insights that support customer growth and expansion. You’ll also design scalable data models and schemas to enable reliable analysis and reporting, while partnering closely with Product and Engineering to design and analyze experiments for new customer-facing features.

Responsibilities:

- Work at the intersection of product analytics, machine learning, and fraud and risk to uncover insights that improve product performance.

- Own the metrics, dashboards, and experiments that inform product strategy and decision-making.

Qualifications:

- 3-5 years of relevant experience, including at least 2-3 years working extensively with product analytics, experimentation, or data-driven products.

- Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience analyzing complex datasets and translating insights into action.

- Hands-on experience with product analytics, experimentation, and/or backtesting methodologies.

- Experience building and maintaining dashboards, reporting frameworks, and core product metrics.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex analyses into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice-to-Have:

- Experience in fraud/risk domains

- Experience with developing ML models

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

title: Growth + Content Strategist – Creative Travel
description:
Application Deadline: July 20, 2025
Remote | Contract
Commitment: ~24 hours/week on a monthly retainer, with potential to transition to full-time after 4 months.

About VAWAA :

VAWAA is a unique marketplace that connects guests with master artists worldwide for immersive, one-on-one creative apprenticeships. At our core, we believe in reviving meaningful human connection through hands-on creativity -craft as a universal language that bridges cultures and transforms lives. We’re a small, mission-driven team dedicated to growing our impact and tripling revenue in 2025 by deepening guest engagement and optimizing our booking funnel.

The opportunity:

We’re looking for a hands-on Growth + Content Strategist who combines strong growth marketing skills with expert storytelling and copywriting. This is not a typical content role-you will own and drive email and newsletter strategies that convert subscribers into bookings, run growth experiments, and work closely with the founder and artist teams to help share VAWAA ’s mission of authentic creative connection.

What success looks like:

• Dramatically increase email-driven bookings from our existing subscriber base, while amplifying the message of creativity as connection.

• Own and craft powerful, compelling email content whether newsletters, drip sequences, campaigns, or reactivations that deeply connects with our audience and drives bookings.

• Strategically plan, segment, and execute email marketing campaigns, including A/B tests and lifecycle nurturing.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to improve landing pages and user flows with a focus on storytelling and experience.

• Use data to continuously test, learn, and refine growth strategies that honor our mission.

• Champion the storytelling that brings VAWAA ’s creative and cultural mission to life in every message.

Who you are:

• You have proven experience growing newsletters or email programs focused on driving meaningful conversions and business growth (beyond editorial content).

• Exceptional copywriter who crafts clear, compelling, and emotionally resonant emails, landing pages, and CTAs that inspire action and convey deep human connection.

• Skilled in lifecycle marketing including segmentation, nurture, reactivation, and A/B testing.

• Comfortable with data and metrics, running growth experiments, and making decisions based on results.

• Preferably experienced with early-stage startups, marketplaces, or creator economy platforms.

• Passionate about craft, culture, and immersive experiences, and able to communicate brand ethos with nuance and authenticity.

• Experienced with highly considered, emotional, aspirational products or experiences that have longer, friction-heavy buying cycles.

Compensation & Commitment:

This is a contract role (~24 hours/week) with a competitive monthly retainer of $2,500-3,500 plus performance-based bonuses tied to growth milestones. After a 4-month initial period, there is strong potential to transition to a full-time position with a salary range of $75,000-$100,000 plus potential equity. We value ownership, creativity, and a growth mindset, and offer flexibility along with meaningful impact.

Why join us?

At VAWAA , you’ll help bring creative, authentic human connection to life on a global scale . You’ll have direct ownership of growth strategies with real impact, in a mission-driven environment that values creativity, authenticity, and meaningful experiences. This is your chance to make a difference through storytelling and growth that honors the power of hands-on artistry and shared creative journeys.

Note: We are based in New York, but open to remote applications from within the US, Canada, Western Europe to allow time zone overlap.
Tip: Cover Letters that include a link to a short 5 min video explaining why you are the best person for this role will be given preference.

description:

title: Manager, Sales Development - NYC
description:
About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders and dropouts alike, now building out our New York go-to-market team.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

We are looking for an SDR Manager to lead and scale our New York sales development team.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This role will own the day-to-day performance of Exa's New York sales development team and will build a top performing team that drives quality pipeline across the growth and enterprise segments. This person is responsible for the quality and volume of pipeline the team generates for our Account Executives. You'll report to the Head of Business Development, and you will own hiring, onboarding, and coaching of the New York SDR team.

This role will be part of the founding team in our New York office. We are looking for someone that is genuinely passionate about AI and is excited to be part of a high-growth, outbound-focused environment.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Own the day-to-day team management, coaching, and development of the SDR team

- Continuously refine and uplevel outbound account targeting, messaging, and multi-channel sequencing (call, email, LinkedIn), in partnership with Head of Business Development, marketing and sales leadership to drive quality pipeline

- Own hiring, onboarding, and ramp for the New York SDR team

- Develop a winning team culture for the NYC SDR team

YOU SHOULD HAVE

- 4+ years of experience in SaaS sales or business development, including 1-2+ years directly managing an SDR or BDR team, ideally at a high-growth startup

- A track record of your team hitting or exceeding pipeline targets

- Experience hiring, coaching, and building top performing outbound SDR teams

- Experience managing both an inbound and outbound motion

- Familiar with our core GTM tech stack, including Salesforce, Amplemarket, Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Centralize

- A successful track record of hands on coaching and developing SDRs into Account Executives

- Experience scaling a team through a similar growth stage (Series B/C)

- A point of view on how AI changes sales development, backed by something you've actually built, automated, or changed, not just familiarity with AI tools

- Health and wellness: Premium medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus a monthly wellness benefit, and a monthly commuter benefit.

- Fertility and family planning: Reimbursement for eligible egg freezing and related medical expenses up to a $15,000 lifetime maximum, plus 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, whether through birth, adoption, surrogacy, or foster placement.

- Life at Exa: Lunch and dinner served daily, an office stocked with snacks, coffee, and health supplements

- Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas for exceptional candidates and welcome applicants from all backgrounds and locations.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

At Instacart , we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work-whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop-while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu
Instacart 's business depends on navigating an evolving patchwork of state and local policy, and the Pacific Northwest is an active front in that landscape. Without dedicated, expert representation, key policymakers in the region lack a clear picture of how Instacart 's platform benefits their constituents and the broader ecommerce ecosystem. This role exists to close that gap: building durable relationships with elected officials and stakeholders, shaping legislative and regulatory outcomes, and ensuring Instacart is never caught flat-footed by policy shifts. A year from now, the northwest region will have a well-developed advocate network, proactive campaign infrastructure, and a consistent voice at the table on the issues that matter most to the business.
This position covers the Pacific Northwest, and the ideal candidate will reside in AK, ID, MT, ND, OR, SD, or WA.

• Cross-functional collaboration with Policy Development, Legal, and Public Engagement teams results in integrated advocacy campaigns and coherent state and local policy solutions for key legislative priorities.

• External consultant relationships and annual government affairs budgets are managed effectively, with regular reporting cadences and internal materials keeping cross-functional stakeholders informed of policy developments.

title: Business Director H/F - CDI
Fleet Technician
description:
Do našeho nově vznikajícího skladu v Opatovicích u Hradce Králové hledáme nového kolegu nebo kolegyni na pozici Technika vozového parku (Fleet Technician).

Máš jedinečnou šanci být u toho hned od prvního dne. Budeš to ty, kdo v Opatovicích pohlídá, aby auta pro naše kurýry byla vždy v perfektním stavu a připravená na rozvoz. Ke spolupráci nepotřebuješ znát složité opravy motorů - stačí, když tě baví auta, rád/a komunikuješ s lidmi a chceš nechat svůj otisk na projektu, který budujeme úplně od nuly. Přidej se mezi Rohlíky! :-)

Co tě u nás čeká?

- Péče o auta v provozu: Tvým denním chlebem bude kontrola vozidel, provozních kapalin, výbavy a povinného příslušenství.

- Kontakt s kurýry: Budeš s řidiči denně komunikovat a řešit s nimi stav aut, aby celý náš vozový park šlapal jako po drátkách.

- Drobné opravy: Všechny složitější věci za nás řeší autorizované servisy. Ty si vezmeš na starost jen drobné manuální úkony a běžnou údržbu.

- Technická agenda: Povedeš si pravidelné záznamy a zápisy do technických tabulek, ať máme v datech pořádek.

Jak si tě představujeme?

- Vztah k autům a ŘP sk. B: Auta tě zkrátka baví a jsi aktivní řidič/ka. Předchozí zkušenosti z oboru jsou výhodou, ale ne podmínkou.

- Komunikativnost a týmový duch: Rád/a jednáš s lidmi, umíš se domluvit a potáhneš s námi za jeden provaz.

- Spolehlivost a zručnost: Jsi zodpovědný člověk, nebojíš se vzít za práci a nechybí ti manuální zručnost.

- Práce s PC: Zvládneš běžnou administrativu a zápis dat do počítače.

- Směnový provoz: Nevadí ti pracovat v režimu krátký/dlouhý týden (střídání ranních a odpoledních směn).

Co ti za tvou skvělou práci nabídneme?

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma - nakupuj s 10% cashbackem v podobě kreditů na další nákupy.

- Možnost placeného volna - když si potřebuješ pořádně odpočnout.

- Dotované obědy & občerstvení zdarma - přímo na pracovišti tě čeká dobré jídlo, skvělé kafe a čerstvé ovoce každý den.

- Sbírej hvězdičky a ulov si odměnu - máme super systém vnitrofiremních pochval. S kolegy si navzájem posíláte hvězdičky, které pak snadno proměníš za vouchery do Alzy, Notina a dalších e-shopů.

- Příspěvek na ošatné - ke každé směně ti přihodíme 86 Kč navíc na oblečení.

- Multisport karta - pro tvůj sport i zasloužený relax po práci.

- Fajn firemní akce - umíme vzít za práci, ale i společně oslavit úspěchy na skvělých večírcích.

title: KIP Spring 2027 - Membership and Development Intern - American Legislative Exchange Council
description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

About ALEC
The American Legislative Exchange Council is America’s largest nonpartisan, voluntary membership organization of state legislators dedicated to the principles of limited government, free markets and federalism. Comprised of nearly one-quarter of the country’s state legislators and stakeholders from across the policy spectrum, ALEC members represent more than 60 million Americans and provide jobs to more than 30 million people in the United States.
 
All Americans deserve an efficient, effective and accountable government that puts the people in control. ALEC provides a forum for experts to discuss business and economic issues facing the states. The ALEC model policy library is home to dynamic and innovative ideas that reduce the cost of everyday life and ensure economic freedom. ALEC ideas and publications are the product of countless hours of research, debate and discussion and serve as a toolkit for anyone who wants to increase the effectiveness and reduce the size, reach and cost of government. ALEC is proud to offer real solutions to the top issues facing the states, and the strength of the ALEC family is proof that good ideas are better when shared.
 
About the Role
The Membership and Development Intern would work closely with the entire membership department on fundraising efforts. He/she would assist with membership outreach to both legislative and private sector members and help members maximize their membership experience with the organization.
 
The intern would work closely with the membership team to understand the goals and big picture of non-profit fundraising. Daily activities will include assisting with renewal efforts, database maintenance and member correspondence.

Stand Together Fellowships believes that diversity in experiences, perspectives, knowledge and ideas fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. Our admissions office treats all program participants and applicants with honesty, dignity, respect and sensitivity. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of color, race, religion, religious creed, sex, gender or gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, ethnicity, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy (including medical needs which may arise from pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), military and veteran status, genetic information, marital or familial status, political affiliation, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances.

title: Video/Streaming Engineer (part-time)

We work with industry-leading organizations to design, build, and operationalize technology solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

Following the acquisition of Tooploox, a premier AI and product development company, Solvd now offers true end-to-end delivery-from strategic advisory and solution design to custom AI development and enterprise-scale implementation. Our capability centers combine deep technical expertise, proven delivery methodologies, and sector-specific knowledge to address complex business challenges quickly and effectively.

We are looking for a Video & Streaming Engineer to join a greenfield digital news platform build for a major international news brand. Video is not a feature here - it is the product. The platform is built around an always-on livestream, automated broadcast clip ingestion, and a player architecture that needs to perform reliably under the extreme traffic conditions of breaking-news events.

You'll own the video and streaming layer end-to-end: platform integration, adaptive playback, livestream workflows, newsroom clipping tools, advertising, analytics, and resilience testing ahead of launch.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own video, livestream, and player technical implementation across the platform.

- Integrate the selected video platform and player with the broader content and delivery architecture.

- Implement adaptive bitrate streaming and device-aware playback across web and mobile environments.

- Support livestream and breaking-news streaming workflows - including failover and resilience requirements.

- Implement clipping and newsroom video-processing capabilities for broadcast clip ingestion and editorial use.

- Integrate captions, subtitles, thumbnails, and poster frames.

- Support rights management, availability-window controls, and geoblocking requirements.

- Integrate video advertising and analytics capabilities.

- Implement playback telemetry, error handling, and fallback logic.

- Support load testing, resilience validation, and major-event readiness testing ahead of launch.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Hands-on experience integrating and configuring enterprise video platforms - Brightcove, JW Player, Mux, THEOplayer, or similar.

- Strong understanding of adaptive bitrate streaming - HLS, DASH - and device-aware playback implementation.

- Experience implementing livestream workflows in a production environment.

- Familiarity with video processing concepts - clipping, transcoding, thumbnail generation, caption and subtitle integration.

- Experience integrating video advertising - VAST, VPAID, or similar - and video analytics.

- Ability to implement playback telemetry, error detection, and fallback handling.

- Experience supporting performance and resilience testing for high-traffic video delivery scenarios.

- Strong collaboration skills - able to work across CMS, frontend, and infrastructure teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience delivering video infrastructure for news, media, or broadcast organizations.

- Familiarity with rights management, availability windows, and geoblocking implementation.

- Experience with CDN configuration for video delivery at scale.

- Background working on platforms designed for major-event traffic spikes.

- Familiarity with DRM implementation - Widevine, FairPlay, PlayReady.

- Experience with poster frame, chapter marker, and structured metadata workflows for editorial video.

When you join Solvd, you'll…

Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.  

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock , TPG (The Rise Fund) , SoftBank, Glynn Capital , NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As Manager of Inside Sales at Human Interest, your primary responsibility will be to coach and develop a high-performing team. The team is responsible for engaging new partners for lead generation of small businesses to become part of the fastest-growing 401(k) company in the world. They will manage a comprehensive sales funnel, requiring mastery in both acquiring net new partners and cultivating ongoing relationships to ensure a continual flow of leads through their pipeline.
The team will look to your guidance and mentorship to help enable their success. You’re the right fit for this role if you are passionate about accelerating revenue, comfortable rolling up your sleeves, and have a strong bias to insight-driven action. You should be naturally curious and have the “go deep” mindset. And as we go 24,791 mph, you should be comfortable with change.

What you get to do every day

• Lead a Tech-Enabled Engine: Spearhead a high-velocity inside sales partnership engine designed to scale referral agreements and expand nationwide market reach.

• Scale Messaging & Sequences: Continuously test and refine persona-aligned outreach sequences and talk tracks to optimize connect rates and meeting conversions.

• Manage Full-Funnel Execution: Oversee pipeline performance across the entire partner lifecycle, from net-new partner acquisition to ongoing relationship management and AE handoffs.

• Align Cross-Functionally: Collaborate with Revenue Operations and Partnership leads to establish operational SLAs, refine target list criteria, and streamline automated lead routing.

• Elevate Rep Competency: Conduct rigorous 1:1 coaching, weekly activity tracking, and bi-weekly call reviews to sharpen value-based pitching, objection handling, and partner negotiations.

• Drive Data-Backed Forecasting: Maintain rigorous accountability around team performance, providing weekly commit forecasts based on activity volume, lead-to-opportunity conversion, and downstream revenue impact.

• Optimize Funnel Integrity: Monitor appointment conversion and follow-up cadences to eliminate drop-off, enforcing key operational targets like maintaining an 80% to 90% show rate.

• Institutionalize Best Practices: Transform high-performing manual prospecting tactics into scalable, automated playbooks as the experimental motion matures.

Key metrics include:

• Team consistently hitting quota (not missing more than two consecutive months)

• Lead and motivate a team of individuals

• Ensure minimal drop off for appointments attended, maintaining an 80% to 90% show rate

• Sales metrics:

• Lead to Opportunity rate

• Lead to Closed Won rate

• Performance metrics:

• Daily activity tracking

• Partner activity follow up

What you bring to the role

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field preferred.

• Proven experience in a Sales Development Representative, role or a similar sales position.

• Minimum of 3 years of Sales team management experience

• Strong understanding of sales processes, lead generation, sales engagement tools (Outreach and Gong) and CRM tools (Salesforce)

• Technologically savvy; able to pick up new systems and technologies qu

title: UX Designer
description:
About Us
Higharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised over $175M with support from top-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors: industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.
Higharc is seeking an accomplished UX Designer to join our growing Product org. In this role, you'll define and craft end-to-end experiences that simplify the complex-and make home design and construction more accessible, efficient, and human.
What You'll Do
You’ll work alongside a multidisciplinary team of engineers, architects, and 3D visualization experts to design tools that serve builders, buyers, and everyone involved in bringing homes to life. Your work will have a lasting, real-world impact and play a critical role in shaping the future of the homebuilding industry. Expect to:

• Design End-to-End Experiences: Lead the UX and UI design of web-based tools across Higharc ’s platform.

• Simplify the Complex: Translate detailed workflows into clear, human-centered experiences.

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with product managers and engineers to ensure cohesive product thinking. Partner closely with homebuilders, suppliers, contractors, and buyers to understand their needs and pain points.

• Own Design Process: Develop user flows, journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals to articulate design intent.

• Influence Product Strategy: Bring a strong, user-focused design perspective to product decisions.

• Validate with Data: Leverage both qualitative and quantitative user insights to inform and iterate on designs.

• Champion Design Systems: Contribute to and evolve our design system to ensure consistency and scalability.

About You
You’re a product-minded designer who thrives on solving complex problems and crafting user-centered solutions. You’re passionate about improving how people design and live in their homes-and energized by the opportunity to make a meaningful dent in an outdated industry.
You have:

• 7+ years of experience designing web-based software

• A track record of shipping high-quality, thoughtful product experiences in complex domains

• A strong portfolio that showcases your process, thinking, and ability to simplify complexity

• Deep user empathy and a clear, confident communication style-especially when working with cross-functional teams

• A systems-thinking mindset with the ability to balance detail with big-picture product vision

• Experience in defining and delivering net-new experiences, not just iterating on existing patterns

• Comfort articulating trade-offs, managing ambiguity, and driving toward clarity in fast-moving environments

A major plus if you also bring:

• A background or passion in architecture, construction tech, or home design

• Familiarity with 3D tools or environments (e.g., Revit, Rhino, SketchUp, Unity, Three.js)

• Experience contributing to or evolving a design system

Working at Higharc

Remote work and travel: Our company is entirely remote, and has been since we were founded in 2018. Remote work means more time with family, less time commuting, and the flexibility to blend work and life. We value in-person collaboration and asynchronous deep-work time, which is why we schedule regular team meet-ups in our hubs across the US and, depending on the role, prioritize hiring in those hubs. If your role requires frequent travel beyond pre-scheduled team meet ups, we will represent that to the best of our ability as early as possible in the interview process.
Compensation and benefits: Higharc offers competitive salaries with significant equity, in a fast-growing, well-funded company. We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with flexible PTO, and meaningful maternity/paternity leave to all U.S based employees that are full-time. You'

title: Lead Tool & Gauge Technician
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE SITE

Anduril, a leader in autonomous systems and weapons manufacturing, is building Arsenal-1 , its first hyperscale manufacturing facility, just south of Columbus, Ohio in Pickaway County. Arsenal-1 is redefining the scale and speed that autonomous systems and weapons can be produced for the United States and its allies and partners. This is a monumental and essential step toward rebuilding America’s defense industrial base, strengthening America’s warfighting capabilities, and enhancing deterrence amid rising international threats.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our team is building and scaling production of next-generation autonomous air vehicles at Arsenal. We own the full integration line, from subassembly through final acceptance testing, and are ramping from early production into rate. The team works hand-in-hand with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, and MRB to solve problems on the floor and get units out the door.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Lead Tool & Gauge Technician is the site's asset management lead for tooling and calibrated gauges: sourcing and
maintaining the tools, gauges, and consumables production depends on; tracking every calibrated asset on site per
program requirements and working alongside the calibration team; enforcing tool control and FOD prevention
procedure; and operating the site's Tool Crib so every technician has reliable access to the tooling they need, when
they need it. This role is also the named point of contact for tooling and asset management objective evidence
supporting AS9100 quality system compliance and DCMA surveillance activities.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Own asset management and control procedure for all calibrated instruments on site: serve as the sole tracker of location and ownership in the calibration registry at all times.

• Maintain objective evidence for Standard Tool & Equipment Inventory and calibration compliance artifacts required under AS9100 and manufacturing readiness level (MRL) assessment.

• Support DCMA surveillance activities with accurate, audit ready tooling and asset records.

• Own and govern the site's tool control procedure: broken tool replacement, tagging, engraving, and ownership handoff to station leads.

• Serve as named asset management POC for manufacturing readiness assessments and produce the calibration compliance artifact when required.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, which requires regular interaction with production and manufacturing stakeholders and frequently working directly on the production floor.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Prior experience standing up or running a tool crib / tool control program in an aerospace or defense manufacturing environment, ideally under AS9100 and DCMA oversight.

• High school diploma or equivalent; technical/vocational training in tool & die, machining, quality, or calibration preferred.

• Basic training in tool control and work order release methods; comfortable working with a variety of forms, records, and reports.

• Familiarity with tools, gages, and consumable supplies, with a basic knowledge of storekeeping methods and inventory procedures.

• 3-5 years of relevant tool control / tool crib experience.

• Demonstrated experience tracking calibrated instruments in a registry/ass

title: AI Research Engineer, Pre-Training

We have multiple large, modern, and rapidly growing GPU clusters, and we maintain a very high GPU-to-researcher ratio. We are simultaneously pursuing multiple strategies and developing many model types with different purposes, and we are strongly incentivized to squeeze as much as we can out of our systems. • Experience translating methods between areas of application is highly valued

title: Senior Technical SR&ED Writer (Software Focus)
description:
Job Opening: Senior Technical SR&ED Writer (Software Focus)

Location: Remote

Company: Zero To One Strategic

Reporting to: SR&ED Program Director

Type: Full-time, Remote

Start Date: Immediate

About Zero To One Strategic

Zero To One Strategic is a fast-growing consultancy that helps innovative Canadian companies unlock non-dilutive funding through SR&ED and other government programs. Our team includes former CRA auditors, software engineers, and grant strategists who are passionate about driving results for tech-focused founders and CFOs.

We are not your average SR&ED firm. We embed deeply with clients to craft audit-ready, technically rigorous claims, and we’re looking to expand our team with a sharp, experienced technical writer who speaks the language of software and science.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Technical SR&ED Writer with deep software knowledge, exceptional communication skills, and hands-on experience preparing successful SR&ED claims. You will lead the development of technical narratives that capture the complexity of R&D efforts in areas like machine learning, cloud infrastructure, embedded systems, and enterprise software development.

The ideal candidate holds at least a Bachelor’s in Computer Science or a closely related field , and has direct SR&ED writing experience . You must be ready to hit the ground running.

Key Responsibilities

•
Own the Technical Narrative : Write detailed, CRA-compliant technical reports that clearly demonstrate technological uncertainty, systematic investigation, and advancement.

•
Lead Developer Interviews : Conduct deep-dive interviews with CTOs, engineers, and technical teams to extract core R&D elements.

•
Collaborate Cross-Functionally : Partner with project managers and financial staff to align technical stories with eligible expenditures.

•
Synthesize Complex Info : Translate advanced software concepts into plain language while preserving technical depth.

•
Project Manager : Balance multiple claim deadlines and client relationships in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

•
Stay Compliant : Keep current on CRA SR&ED guidelines and ensure deliverables reflect the latest standards and best practices.

Minimum Qualifications

•
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Software Engineering, or related technical discipline.

•
2+ years of experience preparing SR&ED claims, either in-house or with a consultancy.

• Excellent writing, editing, and research skills.

• Strong grasp of software development lifecycles, system architecture, algorithms, and technical experimentation.

• Ability to manage deadlines and navigate ambiguity with precision and professionalism.

Nice to Have

• Experience working in or with startups or high-growth tech companies.

• Familiarity with Agile development, cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure), AI/ML models, DevOps pipelines.

• Experience with legal, grant, or technical compliance writing.

• Project management background or formal certifications.

Why Join Zero To One Strategic

• Immediate impact and ownership of client-facing technical work.

• Remote-first flexibility with a collaborative, high-performance culture.

• Opportunity to work alongside a talented team of engineers, advisors, and innovators.

• Competitive compensation ($110k-$130k salary that includes bonuses and upside) and room to grow into a senior advisory or technical lead role.

Salary: $110,000 - $130,000 / year Originally posted on Himalayas

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
 
Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies - including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. title: Executive Assistant
description:

• Availability to work during EST business hours

• Rebate Budget Forms: Complete and manage budget forms required for rebate applications.

• Load Letters: Prepare and submit load letters as required by rebate programs.

• Rebate Applications: Prepare, submit, and track rebate applications from start to finish.

• Confidentiality and Discretion: Handle sensitive and confidential financial and business information with the highest level of integrity.

Requirements

• 3+ years' experience as an Executive Assistant, or equivalent experience in finance/accounts administration

• Demonstrated experience with invoicing, reconciliations, or financial document preparation

• Strong proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel for tracking budgets, projects, and documentation

• Experience with, or strong aptitude for, application or grant/rebate-style administrative processes (intake, documentation tracking, status reporting, and closeout)

• Comfortable communicating with external program administrators and stakeholders via email and Microsoft Teams

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively

title: Social Media Manager
description:
About us

SwimOutlet is the largest online specialty retailer for swimming and water sports in the US, and part of Spiraledge, whose brands include EverydayYoga, Swim.com, Practyce and Tend. We are a small marketing team running more than ten million dollars a year of paid media in house across about ten channels, and we move fast.

The role

You own SwimOutlet's organic social presence end to end, and you own the production of our social and paid social creative. Publishing and scheduling are part of it, and so is repurposing what we already have. We are looking for a maker: someone who shoots and edits video, produces UGC, cuts motion graphics and builds statics, and who can make content that is authentically of the swim world and content that actually sells product. Knowing the difference between those two things is most of the job.

You will have internal design and digital media support and a freelance budget to extend your capacity. The output is still yours.

You will also run our ambassador program as a measurable channel, manage community, and work weekly with the CMO on the paid content pipeline.

You will not buy media or run the ad accounts; our paid media team does that. You will be expected to read the results with us every week and change what you make because of them.

What you will own

Content production

• Make the work. You are our primary producer of social and paid social creative across short-form video, UGC, motion graphics and statics.

• Shoot and edit on demand and on location, including on a pool deck and at meets, around launches and campaign moments.

• Produce a consistent pipeline of testable creative for Meta and our other paid social channels, agreeing weekly with the CMO on what to make next.

• Direct and produce UGC through our ambassador roster and creator network.

• Publish and schedule across our channels. This is a hands-on role and posting is part of it.

• Repurpose what we already have into new formats and placements: cutting longer footage into shorts, reworking UGC into paid ads, adapting statics across surfaces.

• Use our internal designers, the digital media team and external freelancers to extend your capacity. They support the output, you own it.

• Use AI tools wherever they genuinely speed things up: ideation, scripting, editing, and image or video generation.

Channel strategy and operations

• Own SwimOutlet's and our private label Sporti's organic social presence end to end across prioritized channels: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts.

• Run a full audit of our branded social channels in your first 60 days and recommend what to prioritize, maintain or sunset.

• Operate those channels to a high standard: planning, production, publishing, community management and performance tracking.

• Manage Tolstoy shoppable video for on-site and retention relevance.

Creative testing and performance

• Lead creative ideation and testing for paid social: hooks, angles, copy, formats.

• Meet weekly with the CMO to review paid creative performance and agree what to produce more of.

• Own creative-side performance analysis: CTR, CPM, thumbstop rate, hook rate, hold rate, engagement rate and outbound CTR.

• Turn that analysis into clear calls on which angles and formats to double down on.

Community and ambassador program

• Run the ambassador program as a measurable channel, including UGC and influencer sourcing within it.

• Recruit, brief, track output and evaluate ROI per ambassador, and refine the roster toward the highest-value partners.

• Manage community engagement across DMs, comments and tagged content.

• Escalate anything sensitive on PR, CX or legal with good judgement about what needs to come to the CMO.

Product and merchandising alignment

• Keep a clear feed of prioritization inputs from the buying and planning teams so social reflects business priorities.

• Surface priority products, launches and promotional moments through our existing marketing meeting

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work-whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop-while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart operates at the intersection of food access, gig economy labor, and marketplace regulation, making legislative and regulatory engagement a core business function, not an afterthought. As the regulatory landscape around gig economy platforms, marketplace operators, and labor practices continues to evolve rapidly, the Legislative and Labor Team needs a skilled lawyer to analyze emerging requirements, build compliance frameworks, and shape the regulatory conversation before it shapes Instacart. Without this role, gaps in legal analysis and compliance strategy could create operational risk across multiple areas of the business. A year from now, Instacart will have stronger legal frameworks in place, clearer compliance strategies across regulatory domains, and a more coordinated voice in the cross-industry conversations that define the rules of the road for the gig economy.

• Cross-functional regulatory responses are coordinated with clarity: Policy and Government Affairs, Operations, Product, and Communications teams have a consistent, well-analyzed legal perspective on legislative matters affecting Instacart's operations.

• Legal frameworks and compliance best practices for meeting legislative and regulatory mandates are developed and documented, giving the company a foundation to navigate evolving requirements with confidence.

• Instacart's relationships with external counsel, trade associations, and industry partners are actively managed, with cross-industry initiatives underway that contribute to shaping the regulatory conversation in favor of gig economy innovation.

• Expertise in emerging areas of law relevant to Instacart's business is built and shared internally, ensuring the team is prepared to respond to new legal challenges as they arise.

 

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

• Juris Doctor (JD) degree.

• 3+ years of experience practicing law.

• Demonstrated ability to synthesize, analyze, and provide precise legal advice in response to legislative updates.

• Experience working with legislative bodies, government agencies, or regulatory matters.

• Proven success in supporting compliance initiatives and executing legal frameworks.

• Understanding of legislative processes and the regulatory landscape.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

• Experience with legislative or regulatory strategy.

• Familiarity with issues facing marketplace platform companies, gig economy platform companies, or similarly highly regulated businesses

- Start-up Equity

- Competitive Salary

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Founder Relations Associate
description:
We are hiring a Founder Relations Associate to be the first person founders speak to at Pairs, and to help the right ones start working with us.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

THE ROLE

Founders who are raising hear a lot of pitches. Yours is the conversation that earns their trust, because it is about their raise, not about us.

On the first call, you learn where the company is, how much it is raising, who is already interested and what has stalled. Then you decide, with them, whether Pairs is the right next step.

When it is, you walk them through how we work and what it costs, and book the next conversation on the call. When it is not, you tell them so, and stay in touch until the timing is right.

Some founders are better served by our platform tier. For them, you run the demo and close it yourself.

We work with founders across the US, Europe and the Middle East. The expectations you set are the ones we deliver against, so you only promise what we do.

You will work directly with the two co-founders and our closing team. The organisation is flat, so you will see first-hand how we screen companies, what we decline and why.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- First conversations. A call that leaves every founder better informed about their raise, whether or not they work with us.

- The founder's picture. Round, traction, runway, investor interest and the real blocker, captured clearly for the team.

- The next step. Booked on the call, with the context the next person needs.

- Founder relationships. The founders who are not ready yet, kept warm until they are.

YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU

- Have worked closely with founders: at an accelerator, a VC platform team, a startup, or in a founder-facing commercial role.

- Have turned conversations into commitments, and can walk us through one where the founder was hesitant.

- Understand how a raise works: stage, round structure, lead investors, and why investors pass.

- Set expectations you can stand behind. You never promise an outcome, and you would rather lose a deal than oversell one.

- Build trust quickly with founders from different markets and backgrounds.

- Use AI tools daily, with clear judgement about where they improve your work and where they would compromise its quality.

WHAT WE OFFER

- A fully remote role, with working hours that overlap US Eastern time, where most of our founders are

- Direct access to the co-founders and our closing team

- Close collaboration with our internal team

- A sales process that already works, and recorded calls to learn it from

- Insight into how we screen companies and match them with investors

- A base salary plus commission

title: Systems Engineer - Data Security
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll help build and maintain Data Security products as a Software Engineer. These products empower customers to gain deep visibility into Cloud/SaaS security opportunities and into trends in their network traffic and product use. As an engineer on the team, you will focus on building new functionality into our APIs and distributed code while ensuring the performance and reliability of our services which ingest millions of data points each day. You’ll be joining a team of bright, knowledge-seeking engineers who are truly missionaries in solving the security and network visibility challenges for our customers.

Technologies we use:

• Products are written in Go, Python, and Typescript.

• Code runs on Kubernetes, Cloudflare Workers, AWS, GCP, Azure.

• We utilize Postgres as our data store, Redis as our cache, and Kafka as our message broker.

• Our frontend is written in Typescript and React.

• For service monitoring we use Prometheus and Grafana.

• For service logging we use Elasticsearch and Kibana.

• For product analytics we use Clickhouse and BigQuery. 

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, and experience:

• 3+ years of professional experience building and managing reliable and performant software systems at scale, preferably with technologies like: Go, Python, Postgres

• Passion for making the digital world a more secure place

• Excellent debugging and optimization skills

• Willingness, curiosity, and enthusiasm to learn new programming languages, technologies and systems

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Caring and empathy are coveted traits here!

Bonus

• Frontend programming experience in Typescript/Javascript

• Previous experience working with third-party API integrations

• Previous experience working on security products

 
What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

title: Strategic Account Executive, Productivity
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Axon’s Productivity Team is transforming Corrections by giving officers time back, strengthening investigations, and accelerating justice with the first AI-era productivity suite for correctional officers, investigators and leadership. As a Strategic Account Executive, you’ll lead that revolution.

As a Strategic Account Executive on Axon’s Productivity Team, you will lead high-stakes, consultative sales efforts with the largest Corrections agencies in the U.S. This role goes beyond traditional RMS sales - you will bring together Axon Records, Axon Standards, and Axon’s rapidly expanding suite of AI-powered productivity tools to deliver transformational outcomes for agencies.

This is a quota-carrying, senior-level role that demands precision, creativity, and executive presence. You’ll guide Corrections executives, investigators and command staff through the shift from outdated, legacy systems into a future where Axon is the central nervous system of day-to-day Corrections - improving officer productivity, investigation time, and safer outcomes for correctional staff and residents.

What You’ll Do

Location: Remote, National Role

Reports to: Director of Productivity

• Be a Trusted Advisor: Act as a strategic partner to executives, investigators, and IT staff advising on how AI-powered productivity solutions can modernize operations and improve correctional safety outcomes.

• Drive Strategic Deals: Lead discovery and execution in long-cycle, high-value deals across Records management, Standards, and AI tools; align stakeholders across agencies and shepherd procurement through complex processes.

• Sell Innovation: Position Axon’s Productivity Suite as the first platform of its kind - an AI-era ecosystem that transforms Corrections from legacy, paper-based processes into “see, respond, report + close, and strengthen.”

• Deliver Impactful Demonstrations: Lead compelling, scenario-driven demos with support from solution engineers to show how Records and AI unlock measurable staff efficiency and investigative outcomes.

• Align Internally: Collaborate across Sales, Product, Professional Services, Legal, and Marketing to ensure customer success from first conversation to final close.

• Shape the Market: Represent Axon at regional and national Corrections conferences, contributing to our thought leadership in AI, productivity, and the future of records.

• Forecast with Precision: Maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in Salesforce, while developing territory strategies that build long-term growth and category leadership.

What You Bring

• Proven Success in Complex Enterprise SaaS Sales (7+ years) with a track record of exceeding quota in multi-stakeholder, consultative deals.

• Experience Selling Disruptive Technology - ideally AI, cloud, or digital transformation solutions in highly regulated industries.

• Executive Presence & Gravitas: Able to confidently engage executives, investgators and CIOs with clarity, credibility, and influence.

• Consultative Expertise: Adept at uncovering latent customer needs, guiding long-cycle strategies, and aligning solutions to measurable ROI.

• Public Safety Knowledge (Preferred): 2+ years selling to or working with law enforcement, Corrections, PSAPs, or justice systems.

• Startup + Scale Experience: Comfortable operating in high-growth environments with a balance of autonomy and collaboration.

• High Trave

title: Acoustic Engineer (Canada)
description:
Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit of Salas O’Brien, is seeking an experienced Acoustic Engineer to join our growing team, with a primary focus on delivering complex mission-critical projects, including hyperscale and enterprise data centre facilities.

Role Summary

The Acoustic Engineer will provide acoustical engineering expertise throughout the design and delivery of complex mission-critical projects. This role will focus on assessing and addressing noise and vibration challenges associated with data centres and other critical facilities, while working closely with multidisciplinary engineering and design teams.

The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise in acoustical engineering, with experience in noise and vibration analysis, sound control, and the development of practical acoustical solutions for complex facilities. The candidate should also have experience reviewing and understanding noise/nuisance ordinances and codes from AHJs for the purpose of creating compliance frameworks modelling constraints.

The Acoustical Engineer will collaborate closely with clients, architects, mechanical and electrical engineers, BIM/VDC professionals, and other stakeholders to ensure acoustical requirements are effectively integrated into project designs.

This role is ideal for an experienced acoustical engineer who is comfortable working in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment and has a strong understanding of acoustical principles, building systems, and the unique noise and vibration challenges associated with mission-critical facilities and data centres.

What We Offer:

• Experience in a high-tech industry within an international company

• Unique, cutting-edge data centre projects

• Comprehensive training and professional development support

• Supportive management and a dynamic team environment

• Career growth potential

• Ability to work from home

• Competitive employee benefits: Health insurance, Life insurance, Short-term and long-term disability, many other benefits, including PTO.

• Opportunity to participate in the company’s retirement plan

• Stock ownership / synthetic equity options

What You Will Do:

• Lead acoustical engineering, noise, and vibration control activities for mission-critical data centre projects.

• Perform environmental noise assessments, predictive noise modelling, acoustical calculations, and technical analyses using industry-standard tools and methodologies.

• Assess noise generated by generators, chillers, cooling towers, dry coolers, air handling systems, pumps, transformers, fans, and other mechanical and electrical equipment.

• Evaluate cumulative equipment noise and potential impacts at property lines and nearby noise-sensitive receptors.

• Develop practical noise mitigation strategies, including equipment selection criteria, acoustic barriers, enclosures, silencers, louvers, attenuation systems, and other noise control measures.

• Develop vibration isolation and control recommendations for mechanical and electrical equipment.

• Establish project-specific acoustical design criteria and equipment sound requirements that meet the standards of AHJs.

• Review manufacturer sound data, equipment selections, shop drawings, equipment submittals, and contractor RFIs to verify compliance with project acoustical requirements.

• Identify potential acoustical risks during early project phases and provide recommendations before equipment layouts and selections are finalized.

• Prepare acoustical reports, specifications, design criteria, and construction documentation.

• Coordinate acoustical requirements with mechanical, electrical, structural, architectural, controls, and other engineering disciplines.

• Support construction-phase troubleshooting, field noise and vibration measurements, site assessments, and post-construction verification as required.

• Support commissioning activities to verify acoustical performance and alignment with design intent.
